title: UC4 loan 4 period-2 schedule interest (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing ONE period's interest of UC4 loan 4 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_INT_RECALC_DAILY_MULTIDISB_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule transcribes the outstanding principal the period accrues on, periods[1].principalLoanBalanceOutstanding 803.38 -> "80338" minor units, annualInterestRate 12.0 -> 12, and the terms' declared day basis daysInYearType.id 360 / daysInMonthType.id 30. expect.interest_minor transcribes the period's observed interestDue 8.03 -> "803" minor units. The observed 8.03 is NOT a HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie (803.38*12*30/(100*360) = 803), so this vector corroborates the interest cell but does not discriminate the rounding mode (the pinned LN-L06 cell does). period 1 (2025-01-01..2025-02-01) straddles the 200.00 tranche dated 2025-01-15, so its observed interestDue 11.10 is a BLEND of two outstanding principals and is not the seam's single-principal 360/30 formula; it is REFUSED. Period 2 accrues on the constant 803.38 and is transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
